caption:
Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

Surah An-Nahl (16:90). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese and Malay.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #AnNahl #Adl #IslamicReminder #Deen

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 16:90, Surah An-Nahl (The Bee), a Meccan verse widely regarded as one of the Quran's most comprehensive single-verse summaries of Islamic ethics: Allah commands justice, good conduct (ihsan) and generosity to relatives, and forbids immorality, bad conduct and oppression. Chosen as today's post after reviewing short, mainstream, single-ayah candidates outside the surahs already covered by the 28 published posts; this is the first Al-Baqarah-free, first An-Nahl post, with no restricted-addressee or sensitive-scope nuance, and its theme (comprehensive ethical command) is not yet covered by any published post.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/16:90/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih, live-fetched 2026-09-26, HTTP 200. Slide text extracted programmatically from the API response field and asserted byte-identical before writing the slide file. No formatting artifacts.
sourcing.english: Edition en.sahih (Saheeh International), same live API call, HTTP 200. Extracted programmatically and asserted byte-identical to source. No formatting artifacts.
sourcing.chinese: Edition zh.jian (Ma Jian translation), same live API call, HTTP 200. Extracted programmatically and asserted byte-identical to source. No formatting artifacts.
sourcing.korean: Edition ko.korean, same live API call, HTTP 200. Edition metadata lists englishName 'Unknown' for the translator, so the citation slide reads 'translator not specified by source'. The raw source string had four whitespace-only artifacts, confirmed by diffing the extracted text against the raw API response programmatically before writing the slide: three stray inserted spaces splitting single words ('실 천하라' to '실천하라', practice/carry-out; '자 선을' to '자선을', charity; '언행 과' to '언행과', conduct-and) and one missing space between words ('금하심으로너희에게' to '금하심으로 너희에게', forbids / to-you). No character was added, removed or changed; only whitespace was corrected, and the fix is applied to the rendered slide only, not the quoted raw source in this note.
sourcing.japanese: Edition ja.japanese, same live API call, HTTP 200. Same 'Unknown' translator metadata as Korean, so the citation slide also reads 'translator not specified by source' for Japanese. Extracted programmatically and asserted byte-identical to source.
sourcing.malay: Edition ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), same live API call, HTTP 200. Extracted programmatically and asserted byte-identical to source. No formatting artifacts.
sourcing.verification_note: All six editions live-fetched in a single API call this session (2026-09-26) from api.alquran.cloud, HTTP 200, and every slide's text asserted byte-for-byte equal to the corresponding API response field in code (only the Korean slide diverges, by the four whitespace-only corrections documented above) before any slide file was written. Caption pull-quote asserted equal to the English (en.sahih) text. No wording generated from memory.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked programmatically this session against every string term in scripts/data/compliance-policy.json's halal section (prohibited, superstition, origins_patterns; 123 terms) across all slide text, title, caption and tags, using word-boundary regex matching (same approach as scripts/compliance/halal.mjs) to avoid false positives from substrings inside unrelated words. No hits. Pure typography, no imagery, so animate_imagery and context_review do not apply. House style: no em or en dashes, no emoji, UK spelling used throughout the caption.
